_about: Verified default assumptions for True Cost to Own, Compare Homes and Investor Mode. Every value is user-adjustable in the UI. Retrieved and checked 2026-10-28. Rates per $100 of assessed value; NC assesses real property at 100% of appraised value (assessed value may differ from list price until the next revaluation).

tax.note: Combined county + municipal general rate. Excludes special district, fire district and solid-waste fees, which vary by parcel. Bills use the county's assessed value, not the purchase price.

yorkSC.name: York County, SC
yorkSC.note: South Carolina assesses an owner-occupied legal residence at 4% of fair market value (6% for other residential property such as rentals), then applies local millage that varies by school and special district. Millage was not verified for this preview, so enter the rate from the York County tax estimator or your closing attorney.

maintenance.label: Annual maintenance & repairs, % of home value
maintenance.source: Fannie Mae: How to build your maintenance and repair budget (1%–4% of the home's value per year)

alt.name: State Farm: How to budget and save for home maintenance (1% rule)

maintenance.note: Rule of thumb. Older homes, pools and large lots typically run higher.

pmi.label: Private mortgage insurance, % of loan per year (when down payment is under 20%)
pmi.source: Experian, How much does PMI cost? (Urban Institute range 0.46%–1.50%)
pmi.note: Default 0.8% is an assumption within the cited range. Actual PMI depends on credit score, loan-to-value and insurer. FHA/VA loans use different mortgage insurance or funding fees.

mileage.label: IRS standard mileage rate (business), July 1 – Dec 31, 2026
mileage.source: IRS, Standard mileage rates (72.5¢ Jan 1–Jun 30, 2026; 76¢ Jul 1–Dec 31, 2026)
mileage.note: Used only as a proxy for the full per-mile cost of driving (fuel, wear, insurance, depreciation). Commuting is not deductible; this is not tax advice.

utilities.label: Utilities ($/mo), enter your estimate
utilities.note: No verified average is used. Ask the seller or utility (Duke Energy, Charlotte Water, Piedmont Natural Gas) for 12-month history.

rent.label: HUD FY2026 Fair Market Rents, Charlotte-Concord-Gastonia, NC-SC HMFA
rent.area: Charlotte-Concord-Gastonia, NC-SC HMFA (includes Mecklenburg, Cabarrus, Gaston, Union and York SC counties)
rent.source: HUD User: FY2026 Fair Market Rents schedule
rent.note: FMRs are 40th-percentile gross rents (rent + utilities) used for housing programs, a conservative benchmark, not a market rent estimate for a specific home. Homes with 5+ bedrooms are shown against the 4BR figure. Lake Norman areas in Iredell County are outside this HMFA.
